description: get_setting() ignores its default and raises KeyError for unset settings.

issue.title: CLI crashes with KeyError when a setting is not configured
issue.body:
Running the CLI with a config that does not set `proxy` crashes:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/dev/app/settings/cli.py", line 15, in main
    proxy = get_setting(cfg, "proxy", default=None)
  File "/home/dev/app/settings/config.py", line 14, in get_setting
    return settings[name]
KeyError: 'proxy'
```

I expected it to fall back to the default.
